name: Goretek MaintenanceRun Zip Cargo Trouser
description: Loose-fit work trousers in faded brown canvas with eight externally visible maintenance zips — two at each major joint zone, sized for standard and wide-body chrome housings. The zips are heavy brass-tooth in an era of hidden fasteners, and they're meant to be seen: this is a garment built for someone who needs access fast. Knees are double-layered canvas. Hem is adjustable with a snap-tab for different leg configurations.
functionality: Eight maintenance zips positioned at standard chrome joint access zones. Adjustable snap-tab hem for variable leg geometry.
what_it_says: You do real work and your clothes are tools, not statements.
story_hooks: A tech who wears these keeps a small unauthorized tool set in the zip pockets — items that never show on a standard pat-down.
The zipper placement matches a specific corponation's proprietary chrome housing spec; someone is wondering who designed this pattern and why.
